title: The First Token Is Not the Verdict: Hidden Costs of Reading LLM Judges Without Generating
abstract: arXiv:2610.00054v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reading an LLM judge's verdict from the logits of its first generated token is cheap, requires no generation, and is exactly what constrained decoding and likelihood-scoring evaluation harnesses produce. We show that this readout distorts position bias in one direction: it overstates it in every condition we test, so figures obtained this way behave as upper bounds. The mechanism is that judges do not always lead with a verdict token, on 12% to 49% of pairs for three Qwen3 judges and under 3% for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini, and forcing a read on those pairs returns whichever response was shown first rather than a judgment. Pooled over the 924 pairs where a judge did not commit, the forced read flips on 89.7% of them when the responses are swapped, against 47.5% read after generation (paired difference +0.422, 95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]). translated_title: 首个Token并非最终判决：不生成而直接读取LLM裁判的隐性代价
translated_abstract: 从LLM裁判首个生成token的logits中直接读取其判决结果既廉价又无需实际生成，这正是受限解码和似然评分评估框架所产出的结果。我们证明这种读取方式会朝单一方向扭曲位置偏差：在我们测试的所有条件下它都会夸大位置偏差，因此以此方式获得的数值应被视为上界。其机制在于裁判并不总是以判决token作为输出开头——对于三个Qwen3裁判，这种情况出现在12%到49%的样本对上，而对于Llama-3.1-8B和Phi-3.5-mini则低于3%——在这些样本对上强制读取得到的只是先展示的那个回答，而非真正的判断。在裁判未给出明确判决的924个样本对上汇总来看，当交换回答顺序时，强制读取的结果在89.7%的样本对上发生翻转，而生成后读取的翻转率仅为47.5%（配对差异+0.422，95%置信区间[+0.365, +0.467]）。这种扭曲对所测量的指标具有特异性：它使位置偏差移动了42个百分点，而……
tldr: 该论文揭示，直接从首个token的logits读取LLM裁判的判决而不实际生成，会在所有测试条件下系统性夸大位置偏差——因为裁判并非总以判决token开头，强制读取时往往只是重复先展示的回答而非真正判断——因此这种廉价方式测得的数值只能作为上界使用。
en_tdlr: Reading LLM judge verdicts from first-token logits without generation systematically overstates position bias in all tested conditions, because judges do not always lead with a verdict token and forced reads merely echo the first-shown response, making such measurements reliable only as upper bounds.
